verdict.rationale: Docs show real guardrail mechanisms: input/output validation guardrails, human-in-the-loop tool-call approval that pauses runs pending explicit permission, and dedicated 'Sandbox agents' that execute in isolated, manifest-defined workspaces, plus a sandboxed CodeInterpreterTool. Together these give an engineering lead meaningful control over tool use and execution isolation, though there's no first-party doc on granular per-tool ACL/permission policies beyond approval gating, and no independent/hands-on security audit corroborating sandbox robustness. Missing for 10: explicit fine-grained per-tool permission/policy configuration docs, independent verification of sandbox isolation guarantees.
